text:
Emily Chen: AstraPoint reached out — they send "metered_bytes_per_minute" and want weekly invoicing + an "invoice-preview" feed. They also want device-level SKUs. Who can own mapping + recon playbook?

Marcus Li: I can own mapping + shadow runs. Quick clarifying q: meter is bytes/minute per device, right? Any event_id or is it just (device, ts, bytes)?

Leo (AstraPoint): Correct: event has device_id, minute_ts, bytes_min, and event_hash. We keep event_hash for dedup. Weekly cutoff: Sunday 23:59 PST (partner requirement).

Nina Gomez: Good — we'll standardize to GB-minutes for internal billing units: gb_minutes = (bytes_min / 1024^3) * 60. Need to decide rounding (recommend 4 decimal places) and invoice line aggregation rules.

Theo Brooks: Shadow plan: ingest partner feed into staging, de-duplicate by event_hash, convert -> aggregate per-device and per-entitlement for the partner week window, produce invoice-preview CSV (one row per entitlement). Reconciliation: compare partner_total_units vs marketplace_total_units daily and weekly.

Emily Chen: What thresholds? Partner wants tight alignment for GA.

Marcus Li: Propose: daily delta alert if >0.8% or absolute >500 gb_minutes for high-volume entitlements; weekly auto-block if >1% until investigation. Low-volume entitlements (avg <100 gb_minutes/week) use 10% tolerance or 50 gb_minutes absolute.

Priya (Marketing): For marketplace listing we'll use consumer-friendly names: "AstraPoint Device Bandwidth — Starter / Pro / Unlimited". Please map internal SKUs to these labels in the preview CSV.

Nina Gomez: SQL snippet for aggregation (staging):
```sql
SELECT entitlement_id,
  device_id,
  SUM(bytes_min) AS total_bytes_min,
  ROUND(SUM(bytes_min) / 1024.0/1024.0/1024.0 * 60.0, 4) AS gb_minutes
FROM astra_events_staging
WHERE minute_ts >= '{{week_start}}' AND minute_ts < '{{week_end}}'
GROUP BY entitlement_id, device_id;
```

Theo Brooks: CSV schema for preview (one row per entitlement): entitlement_id, sku, label, period_start, period_end, device_count, our_gb_minutes, partner_gb_minutes, unit_price_cents, line_total_cents, notes

Leo (AstraPoint): We'll supply partner_gb_minutes column for easy diffing. We'll also sign webhook HMAC for replayability.

Marcus Li: We'll run a 7-day shadow run. If daily deltas stay under thresholds for 7 days, we flip to GA for weekly invoices. Backstop if ingestion lag >2 hours: route to partner_reported values and mark invoice as provisional. Documented in runbook.

ops-bot: Created ticket MP-410: "AstraPoint bytes/min ingestion + weekly preview" assigned to Marcus Li, watchers: Emily Chen, Nina Gomez, Theo Brooks, Priya (Marketing).

Emily Chen: Action items: Marcus -> mapping table + sample invoice-preview CSV by Fri EOD; Nina -> staging pipeline + dedupe logic by Thu; Theo -> alert rules + runbook fallback; Priya -> marketplace labels + 2 sample previews for marketing. I'll send kickoff doc to AstraPoint and confirm PST cutoff is final.

Marcus Li: I'll also include a small Python validator to check signature + idempotency and post sample rows to MP-410.

Priya (Marketing): Please include one low-volume and one high-volume sample for copy review. Also avoid internal metric names in consumer-facing copy.

Emily Chen: Thanks all — reconvene after day 3 of shadow run. :thumbsup:
